protocol: new anonymous O_TMPFILE descriptor; fsync; linkat from /proc/self/fd with SYMLINK_FOLLOW and no replacement; directory fsync
platform_probe: PASS existing name preserved and new name has one link; scratch removed

scope_inventory.writable handles: private_file validates source device/inode, owner/mode/single link before any data append; apply same ownership predicate to every recognized pre-existing output member
scope_inventory.metadata publication: replace named temporary open/truncate/rename with new anonymous descriptor and non-replacing link; no temporary pathname cleanup
scope_inventory.source reader: read-only descriptor and pre/post identity/hash checks; no mutation
scope_inventory.shared Sink: append only to validated descriptor; never rename or unlink paths
scope_inventory.ordinary neutral archive export: unchanged prior code, outside this source-snapshot mutation contract

why_not_another_path_check: A checked final path can change before replacement; checked temporary names can also be replaced before rename/unlink. Descriptor-owned anonymous bytes remove both mutable-name operations.
support_limit: requires Linux O_TMPFILE and procfs publication support; unsupported filesystem must refuse without a replacing fallback
status: design and platform capability verified; product fix not implemented yet
